This '''factory''' was located on [[Belgaroth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==History==
The factory was run by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Arms]] corporation and ostensibly produced arms for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], but was secretly in league with the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] and their [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] backers. The operation was [[Mission to Belgaroth|exposed]] by the [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] [[Marrt]] and the factory was destroyed by him.
